youtube.title: The Cottingley Fairies: The Hoax That Fooled Sherlock Holmes's Creator (Full Case File)
youtube.description:
In 1917, two cousins in Cottingley, Yorkshire, came home from a stream with a photograph of fairies. Photography experts found no sign of tampering, Sir Arthur Conan Doyle published the pictures in The Strand Magazine as proof that fairies were real, and the girls kept their secret for more than sixty years. This is the complete case file: the five photographs, the believers, the evidence that cracked it, the 1983 confession, and the one photograph Frances insisted was real until the end of her life.

📂 Case File #003: The Cottingley Fairies — full documentary
